plumbing.camera: slow stabilized push-in with slight lateral parallax around the plumber, fixture, pipework, or finished installation
plumbing.motion: subtle water/reflection movement where already visible; gentle worker/tool motion only when present; natural ambient movement

hvac.camera: controlled low-angle push or gentle lateral tracking move around the technician, condenser, furnace, or finished system
hvac.motion: subtle fan movement only if physically appropriate; gentle clothing/foliage movement; shifting natural reflections

electrical.camera: slow precision dolly toward the electrician, panel, lighting installation, or finished electrical work with mild parallax
electrical.motion: subtle worker movement when present; realistic practical-light response; gentle environmental motion

roofing.camera: cinematic drone-like rise and forward glide across the real roofline, or a slow ground-to-roof reveal when the source perspective supports it
roofing.motion: subtle tree movement, cloud drift and sunlight/reflection changes; workers move only if already present

fencing.camera: smooth lateral tracking move following the fence line, then a gentle push toward the finished project
fencing.motion: subtle foliage and grass movement; realistic sunlight and shadow changes

concrete.camera: low cinematic glide across the finished slab, driveway, patio, steps, or decorative surface, creating strong foreground parallax
concrete.motion: subtle foliage, reflections and worker motion only where present; preserve exact concrete texture and edges

landscaping.camera: smooth low drone-like glide through the real landscape, passing near foreground plants or hardscape for strong natural parallax
landscaping.motion: gentle leaves, grasses and branches in a light breeze; subtle water motion if already present; natural moving reflections and sunlight

med_spa.camera: very slow elegant dolly or subtle orbit through the real treatment room or around the provider/client scene without changing faces or equipment
med_spa.motion: extremely subtle natural human motion only if people are present; gentle curtain/hair movement; soft realistic reflections and practical lights

hair_salon.camera: smooth premium dolly through the real salon or gentle orbit around the stylist/client scene while preserving faces and hairstyle
hair_salon.motion: subtle natural hair and human movement where present; realistic mirror reflections and practical lighting

tattoo.camera: slow moody precision push or subtle orbit around the real artist, client, studio, or finished tattoo while preserving the exact artwork
tattoo.motion: minimal believable human movement; subtle practical-light and reflection changes; no movement or mutation inside tattoo artwork

restoration.camera: controlled documentary-commercial push through the real work area or lateral move around technicians/equipment
restoration.motion: subtle worker/equipment/environmental motion only when already present; realistic dust/light/water behavior only if visible in source

general_contractor.camera: cinematic forward glide or lateral reveal through the real completed project, using foreground architecture for strong depth
general_contractor.motion: subtle environmental and worker movement only where present; natural light/reflection changes
